scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.electron:dev: NODE_ENV=development npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx electron .
scripts.electron:build: rm -rf release/* .DS_Store release/.DS_Store && npm run build && cd backend && npm run build && cd .. && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack: rm -rf release/* .DS_Store release/.DS_Store && npm run build && cd backend && npm run build && cd .. && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx electron-builder --dir
